messages:
michelle: Quick heads-up — planning a staged KMS key rotation for account-prod next month. High-level ask: automatic KMS rotation + re-encryption (envelope) for S3/RDS secrets; need guidance on compatibility headers, RBAC for temporary re-encrypt roles, audit logging surge, and vuln triage/rollbacks if issues. What are safe timing windows and canary approaches?
aj: +1. Proposed: 3-wave rollout (canary hosts -> 10% -> 100%). Start with read-only canary decrypt test, then scheduled re-encrypt jobs. Keep old key available to decrypt for 30d.
samir: Important: add a key version header to ciphertext metadata (kver: v2) so new decryptor knows which KEK used. Fallback decryptor should try KEK v2 then v1. Avoid double-encrypt.
emily: RBAC: create a temporary 'key-rotator' role with only Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions in KMS and narrow scope to the specific alias. Audit logs should be forwarded to sec-logs (s3/kinesis) with retention 90d. Also record who triggered re-encrypt jobs in our audit event.
michelle: Example re-encrypt loop (psuedo):
```
for obj in $(aws s3api list-objects --bucket prod-secrets --query 'Contents[].Key' --output text); do
  tmp=$(aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://curr --output text)
  aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/new-prod-kek --plaintext "$tmp" --output text > new_blob
  aws s3api put-object --bucket prod-secrets --key $obj --body new_blob
done
```
Note: that's simplified, add consistency checks and backoff.
aj: I'd add a dry-run mode that writes to a 'canary' prefix and a checksum compare. Also throttle to avoid request spikes. Use concurrency limiter in our job runner.
samir: Regarding vuln triage: if nodes fail decrypt after rotation, we should automatically revert traffic to old key alias and pause further waves. Need a playbook: pause, rollback, gather decrypt-error logs, escalate to oncall, and open incident with RCA deadline 24h.
emily: For audit surge, pre-create dashboards for unexpected decrypt error rates and kinesis alarms for >0.5% error over 5m. Also record user:service principal in index for postmortem.
rotator-bot: rotation-check CI passed for 3 samples. link: https://ci.internal/rotator/1769999999
deploy-bot: created job: rotator/prod/wave-1 scheduled 2026-04-12T04:00Z. 
michelle: Action items: emily to create RBAC role + policy (due 3/31), aj to implement dry-run + canary prefix (due 4/7), samir to update decryptor to support 'kver' header and fallback logic (due 4/5). I'll draft incident playbook & run a tabletop next week. 
emily: ack, will ping infra for entitlement review. :thumbsup:
aj: ack
samir: ack
michelle: thanks all — will post final timeline after infra review. :raised_hands:
